Dear Mr. Lindqvist,

At this point in time, we have completed the first two phases of the audit. You're team has been very responsive, and we appreciate the quick turnaround on the access requests.

Phase three will begin on November 12 and should take about three weeks. We will send the draft findings to you and Ms. Berg by December 5.

Sincerely,
Adaeze Nwosu
